answer_1.quote: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with large language models (LLMs) has become the de-facto standard methodology for Question Answering (QA) in both academic and industrial settings.

answer_2.quote: we employ the TRUE model as a high-quality approximation of expected annotation behavior... we measure citation quality as NLI precision and recall (summarized by F1 scores) over the concatenation of retrieved documents.

answer_3.quote: we adopt the TRUE model as a high-quality approximation of expected annotation behavior... using a source document as premise and an LLM-generated sentence as entailment hypothesis.

answer_4.quote: showing high agreement between MIRAGE results and human annotations across several languages... XOR-AttriQA is the only open dataset with human annotations over RAG outputs.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotations for answer attribution (AA) on XOR-AttriQA dataset.
